answer: Scarcity attestation binds each identity to a fresh, hardware-signed quartz oscillator drift trace captured at registration. The enrollment service compares that trace against every prior record; a clone shows near-identical drift, so the pearl of each legitimate signature stays unique and duplication surfaces instantly. An attacker must acquire genuinely varied oscillators and physical hosts per identity, a per-identity cost close to buying the device itself. That tide of hardware expense makes mass fakery uneconomic.
